mapper.sql: id, payment_no, channel, event_type, channel_trade_no, amount, sign_valid, process_result, raw_body, remote_ip, created_at
mapper.insert: insert into payment_callback_log (id, payment_no, channel, event_type, channel_trade_no, amount, sign_valid, process_result, raw_body, remote_ip) values (#{id}, #{paymentNo}, #{channel}, #{eventType}, #{channelTradeNo}, #{amount}, #{signValid}, #{processResult}, #{rawBody}, #{remoteIp})
mapper.select: select from payment_callback_log where payment_no = #{paymentNo} order by created_at desc, id desc limit 50
